published_ranges._notes: TDS V1.0 (2025/12/1): nozzles 0.2-0.8, fan on, HDT 1.8MPa 52C, melt 163C. Retraction/print-speed/chamber label mapping inferred from the flattened PDF layout (value order matches the other Kingroon V1.0 TDS sheets: retraction length, retraction speed, chamber temp, overhang, bridging ... printing speed). Page (kingroon3d.com, read 2026-11-02) confirms '+/- 0.02mm' tolerance and the marketing claim 'from 50mm/s to 600mm/s' (conflicts with TDS <300 mm/s). page Printing Tips also give: AMS 2 Pro / AMS HT 55C 8h; X1 heatbed 60-70C 12h. Earlier entry: TDS V1.0 (2025/12/1): Cool Plate / High Temperature Plate / Textured PEI with glue; fan on; ABS spool rated 70 C; HDT 1.8 MPa 52 C; melting 163 C. Tolerance from kingroon.com Matte PLA listing. Verification 2026-11-01: fields and plate/chamber/fan/retraction ranges confirmed against the TDS PDF; kingroon.com / kingroon3d.com product pages returned HTTP 429, so page-derived notes and conflicts were not re-checked.
